gaps.title: Cross-format transcoding and additional formats
gaps.detail: Current renderer is same-format copy-through. WebP, SVG and cross-format PNG/JPEG/PDF/etc. conversion are not supported by the runtime.

gaps.title: Resize, quality, alpha, crop and preset dimensions
gaps.detail: ExportRequestItem has no geometry/quality/alpha parameters, so these controls remain hidden.

gaps.title: AI Adapt creates a new DesignVersion
gaps.detail: Aspect-ratio/design adaptation needs a recipe/Agent flow that creates a canonical new DesignVersion before export.

gaps.title: Verified print and color management
gaps.detail: DPI, CMYK, bleed and crop marks require a verified renderer/color-management contract and must remain hidden until then.

gaps.title: Complete export cost estimate
gaps.detail: Copy-through can truthfully state no AI generation fee, but storage/egress/transcoder/future AI adaptation cost is not available through one estimate contract.

gaps.title: Per-item batch failure and retry
gaps.detail: NODE-49 currently marks the overall job FAILED on render/packaging failure and does not expose per-item retry state.

gaps.title: Durable export job listing and reopen
gaps.detail: Known job IDs can be read, but the product has no project-scoped list/activity endpoint to recover a job after page refresh without retaining its ID.

gaps.title: Production ExportEngine composition proof
gaps.detail: The request-scoped export_engine_factory dependency is fail-closed but production factory wiring is not yet proven in this node.

gaps.title: Browser, PostgreSQL and worker E2E
gaps.detail: Need end-to-end proof for exact capability, task/job attribution, queue execution, deterministic package, signed download refresh and tenant authorization.

gaps.title: Hosted GitHub Actions executed green
gaps.detail: NODE-60 cannot be COMPLETE until hosted CI executes actual compile/test/lint/build steps successfully.
